text:
Situation: Omeprazole 20 mg capsules are low at Corvale East with 36 on hand (4.2 days). Corvale General holds two lots totaling 494 capsules (26 days combined). FDA's drug shortage list shows omeprazole is not listed as of 2026-10-21.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows omeprazole is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Proficient Rx LP (FEI 3011557028) is a registered repack/relabel plant whose most recent FDA inspection was VAI on 2022-12-08. Bryant Ranch Prepack (FEI 1000519407) is a registered repack/relabel plant that received an OAI classification on 2009-06-11 and a Warning Letter on 2010-04-08, followed by VAI inspections through 2026-07-16.

Our position: Internal transfer is the fastest way to protect Corvale East supply without new purchasing. External purchases are available from multiple manufacturers not on the shortage list, but their labels do not identify a repack plant we can verify.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 85 capsules of 20 mg from Corvale General to Corvale East — approved by pharmacy director (transfer request).
2. If transfer cannot be completed, purchase from Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. — approved by buyer.
3. If needed, purchase from Apotex Corp — approved by buyer.
4. If needed, purchase from Aurobindo Pharma Limited — approved by buyer.
5. If needed, purchase from AvPAK — approved by buyer.

Not recommended: Delaying the transfer while awaiting new purchase orders; Corvale East would remain below one week on hand.
